formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P12-R1 — Action-Opportunity 2×2 Contingency Representation, Exact-Tuple Collision Census, Outcome-Blind Compression Candidate Tournament, Fresh↔Legacy Common-Support Recovery, Representation-Loss Bounds, Cross-Ancestry Stability & Structural-Opportunity Sufficiency Audit

candidate_representations.omitted: total descending margin beyond low-overlap intersection
total low-overlap margin beyond descending intersection

forbidden_inputs: P12 behavioral residuals by candidate representation
selection_stage.loss_metric: normalized conditional entropy H(full_exact_tuple | compressed_representation) / H(full_exact_tuple), computed on eligible lb6/7/8 states separately in fresh and legacy
selection_stage.common_support_metric: number of solves with at least one lb7 and lb6/8 state sharing progress quintile × compressed representation
selection_stage.selection_rule: among candidates passing all gates, select minimum coordinate count; break ties by lower max(fresh,legacy) normalized conditional entropy, then candidate order listed above

behavioral_stage.weighting: minimum target/comparator state count within matched stratum

adjudication.support_limited: selected representation has fewer than 10 fresh eligible solves at behavioral stage
adjudication.structural_opportunity_sufficient: fresh residual changes sign or abs(residual) <= 0.5 * 0.056231231231231235
adjudication.residual_alignment: fresh residual remains positive and abs(residual) > 0.5 * 0.056231231231231235

inference_boundary: Representation selection is based only on structural opportunity data, never human next-action outcomes.
Entropy retention is an observed-support information audit, not proof of universal sufficiency.
Any selected quotient is descriptive for the observed lb6/7/8 state surface.
No causal or cognitive mechanism promotion.
